The task explicitly permits managed instruction/adaptor updates; independent acceptance verifies exact ownership and source preservation. buildPolicy: The target CLI performs the upgrade and lock regeneration in its private temporary staging area. budget: The subprocess and its descendants have a hard 1800-second deadline. Record total/cached input and output tokens. Reject more than 2000000 total reported tokens or 150000 uncached-input-plus-output tokens. These post-run acceptance ceilings are not guaranteed billing caps.
attemptPolicy: One attempt for each declared task and working directory. No resume, automatic retry, human hints or acceptance-feedback repair. Retain failed attempts and freeze any future profile revision separately.
